what: A six-track groovebox for the FM-1, forked from Skiff: a SYNTH with analog, 303 and Plaits-style oscillators, an acid filter and OberVave presets, a Minimoog voice, classic drum models, more trig conditions, a step arpeggiator, 8-channel USB audio, a web editor and screen mirroring.
author: LIkst4
